rule.description: One Clang-Tidy readability-function-size invocation over the three command-handler modules (the string command module, the generic database/key-expiry command module, and the hash command module) reports every command-handler function that exceeds the calibrated per-subsystem envelope: at least 60 statements, or at least 15 branches, or at least 10 local variables, or control nesting at least 5 levels deep. Untouched command handlers in the same modules stay at or under 47 statements / 10 branches / 9 variables with no nesting level 5, so each reported function is a handler that absorbed multi-layer helper bodies into itself.

checks.description: Detect command-handler functions in the string / key-expiry / hash command modules whose single definition swallowed the bodies of two or more lower layers, crossing the calibrated module envelope on statements, branches, variables or nesting depth.
checks.detected_relation: command handler -> inlined re-implementation of shared pipeline layers (lookup, lazy expiry + propagation, assignment, parse/encode, reply protocol, dual-encoding hash access)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A command handler that delegates is an orchestrator of one-liners; after absorbing sub-method implementations it becomes a multi-layer monolith that duplicates machinery still owned by the shared modules. The envelope over handler functions separates exactly those monoliths from every delegating handler, and remains satisfiable by any sound repair regardless of the names it uses.

matches.evidence: SET/SETNX/SETEX/PSETEX shared write generic carrying the expiry-parameter parse, the conditional-create existence check with its lookup path, the add/overwrite assignment split, stale-expiry removal, the touched-key notification and the expiry-record write all inside the handler body.

GET/GETSET shared read generic carrying the lazy-expiry gate with fully inlined logical-delete propagation, the key lookup with hit/miss statistics and LRU refresh, and the complete reply machinery: buffer fast path, client-list overflow path with tail-concatenation accounting, small-integer shortcut, decode fallback and bulk-header arithmetic.

INCR/DECR/INCRBY/DECRBY shared numeric generic carrying the write-side lookup with expiry gate, the type check, both long-long parse encodings with the missing-value zero fallback, the overflow guard, the counter-object construction with small-integer split, and the add/overwrite assignment.

EXPIRE/PEXPIRE/EXPIREAT/PEXPIREAT shared generic carrying the long-long parse with both encodings, unit scaling and base-time conversion, the DELETE branch with inlined dictionary removal and slots bookkeeping, the dirty counter, the fully inlined client command-vector rebuild for DEL propagation, the touched notification, and the expiry-record write of the update branch.

TTL/PTTL shared query generic carrying the expiry-record read, the inlined lazy-expiry gate with logical delete, the key lookup with statistics and LRU refresh, and three separately hand-expanded integer-reply branches (missing key, no expiry, computed value) each retaining a dead branch from the copied source.

HINCRBY carrying the increment parse, the fully inlined lookup-or-create gate including object construction and the database add path, the field read expanded over both hash encodings with the ziplist decode walk, the current-value parse with hash-specific error, the encoding attempt, the dual-encoding field write with conversion threshold, and the hand-expanded integer reply.

excluded.reference: large functions outside the three command modules (server configuration listing, config-time helpers)
excluded.reason: pre-existing code size outside the command layer; the rule's scope is the command-handler modules whose clean envelope was measured, and these locations can never be reported by the rule's invocation targets

excluded.reference: setrangeCommand, getrangeCommand, appendCommand and other command handlers in the same modules
excluded.reason: untouched by the injection and below the envelope on every metric (module maxima 47 statements / 10 branches / 9 variables / no nesting level 5); they are deliberately not part of this case's locations

excluded.reference: the original shared helper functions still present in the tree (their bodies were copied into the handlers)
excluded.reason: they are the legitimate owners of their responsibilities with normal sizes and delegation; crediting them would misread the smell's direction
